record_title: Universal amplitude barrier and strict period floor for Moore-Spiegel recurrence
provenance: Exact generator balances, a polynomial monotonicity identity, equality-set rigidity, and Wirtinger analysis for the classical Moore-Spiegel oscillator.
limitations: Invariant-measure statements assume compact support. The slab obstruction concerns compact invariant sets rather than arbitrary one-sided bounded trajectories. The result gives necessary recurrence and period constraints, not existence or stability. Originality is to the best of our knowledge, with unresolved full-text priority risk in the 1966 original paper and several later Moore-Spiegel studies.
